newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Dhaka noted with hapiness the developments in New Delhi, facilitating Foreign Minister I K Gujral to become the Prime Minister of India.
Prime Ministr Sheikh Hasina returns home on Monday from Saudi Arabia after peforming hajj.
Two Bangladeshis were gunned down by Indian border guards at the Nimtala-Gede frontier on Thursday.

Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party Secretary General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Sunday said that the ruling Awami League had brought the country's economy on the brink of ruination within 10 months.

Finance MInister S A M S Kibria on Sunday said the South Asian Growth Trinagle, encompassing Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal and Eastern and Northern parts of India, had tremendous opportunities for reaching benefits for the people of the region.
Some 22 people were killed in road mishap across the country in last four days.
Bangladesh and Thailand agreed to expand economic cooperation under joint venture in new areas including fisheries, poultry, composite textile and chemicals.
At least 10 Bangladeshi firms will take part in the Tokyo International Trade Fair in Japan, scheduled to begin on April 24 REUTER
